description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three models—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—across two tweet categories: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet containing emojis,” with the y-axis representing accuracy on a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.8. For “Emoji Tweets,” TEXTBLOB (white bar) achieves approximately 0.4 accuracy, VADER (diagonal hatching) reaches about 0.6, and ChatGPT (solid green) attains roughly 0.8. In the “Overall Tweet containing emojis” category, TEXTBLOB drops slightly below 0.4, VADER remains near 0.6, and ChatGPT again peaks at approximately 0.8. The bars are grouped by category along the x-axis, with each group containing three bars corresponding to the models, and the legend in the upper right identifies each model by its fill pattern or color. The chart visually emphasizes ChatGPT’s consistently higher performance across both categories, with its bars significantly taller than those of TEXTBLOB and VADER, while VADER consistently outperforms TEXTBLOB. The gridlines aid in estimating values, and no bars are shaded or annotated beyond their standard visual encoding.
